hook:
Rally-bred, road-legal.

Toyota built a rally car for the road, then refused to sell it with an automatic.
body:
Built on the same GR-FOUR all-wheel-drive philosophy as the cars Toyota sends rallying, then handed a six-speed manual and no automatic option at all.

2024 Toyota GR Corolla Circuit Edition — 300 hp · 273 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 4.9 sec.

· 300 hp from 1.6 litres is 187 hp per litre — specific output usually reserved for engines with twice the cylinder count.
· The centre exhaust is a working outlet, not a trim panel with a hole in it.
· GR-FOUR all-wheel drive comes from the same programme Toyota goes rallying with.
· Six-speed manual, and no automatic offered at any price.

It occupies a narrow segment: rally-derived all-wheel drive with a manual gearbox.
cta: Would you take 300 hp from three cylinders over 300 hp from four?
